sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 also introduces reasoning_effort, with low, medium, and xhigh levels to trade reasoning depth against cost. Qwen now recommends temperature=1.0 and top_p=0.95 for thinking mode generally, and, for very long agentic runs, recommends allowing up to 262K tokens for reasoning and 131K for the final answer.

sources.title: Deeper Dive: The Qwen 3.8 27B Open Weight Model for Local Agentic AI
sources.snippet: I have previously posted about the importance of considering open-weight models for your agentic AI workflows. One of the more consequential recent open-model releases for agent engineering may be Qwen3.8-27B, released by Alibaba's Qwen team in August 2026.
